title: HB693 (2025 Regular Session): Adds improperly transporting or storing a firearm in a motor vehicle to the offense of unlawful use of a weapon

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.030 (RSMo): Possesses a firearm while also knowingly in possession of a controlled substance that is sufficient for a felony violation of section 579.015; or
Section 571.030 (RSMo): Transports or stores a loaded, concealed firearm in a motor vehicle and outside of a locked container or locked trunk.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): Subdivisions (1) and (12) of subsection 1 of this section do not apply to any person nineteen years of age or older or eighteen years of age or older and a member of the United States Armed Forces, or honorably discharged from the United States Armed Forces, transporting a concealable firearm in the passenger compartment of a motor vehicle, so long as: (1) Such firearm is otherwise lawfully possessed; and (2) One of the following: (a) If the firearm is a handgun, the firearm is under the direct control of the person carrying the firearm; (b) The person is also in possession of an exposed firearm or projectile weapon for the lawful pursuit of game; (c) The person and motor vehicle are in the person's dwelling unit or upon premises over which the person has possession, authority, or control; or (d) The person is traveling on a continuous journey peaceably through this state.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): Subdivision (1), (6), (7), (8), or (12) of subsection 1 of this section shall be guilty of a class B misdemeanor
